description_en: Describes the syntax and provides examples of the MergeImageFace operation for image face fusion
description_zh: 本文介绍图像人脸融合MergeImageFace的语法及示例
name: MergeImageFace

parameters.help_en:
The template ID of the face template.

You must upload a template first. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/203512.html
parameters.help_zh:
人脸模板的模板ID。

需要先上传模版，具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/203512.html
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the face image to be fused. This parameter is used only in single-face template scenarios. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. For local files or OSS URLs in other regions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.
Input limits:
Image format: JPG, JPEG, or PNG.
Image size: No more than 20 MB.
Image resolution: At least 128 × 128 pixels and at most 2000 × 2000 pixels. The longest side must not exceed 2000 pixels.
The URL must not contain Chinese characters.

If the image resolution exceeds the maximum limit, resize the image first. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44688.html.
Specify either ImageURL or MergeInfos
parameters.help_zh:
待融合的人脸照片，仅在模板图为单人场景下使用。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。
输入限制：
图像格式：JPG、JPEG、PNG。
图像大小：不超过20 MB。
图像分辨率：大于等于128×128像素，小于等于2000×2000像素，最长边小于等于2000像素。
URL地址中不能包含中文字符。

当图像分辨率超过最大限制时，请先将图片进行缩放，调整图片大小，具体请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44688.html。
ImageURL与MergeInfos二选一
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The model version. Two model versions are available: face shape adaptation (v1) and non-face shape adaptation (v2), which produce different results. Default value: v1 (face shape adaptation version)
parameters.help_zh: 提供两版模型，分别支持脸型适配（v1）与非脸型适配（v2）的效果，具有一定区分度。默认值为v1（脸型适配版本）
parameters.name: model_version

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to add a watermark. Valid values:

False (default): Does not add a watermark.
True: Adds a watermark
parameters.help_zh:
是否添加水印。取值范围如下：

False（默认）：不添加水印。
True：添加水印
parameters.name: add_watermark

parameters.help_en:
The watermark type. Valid values:

EN (default): English watermark.
CN: Chinese watermark
parameters.help_zh:
水印类型。取值范围如下：

EN（默认）：英文水印。
CN：中文水印
parameters.name: watermark_type

fields.help_en: The URL of the image to replace the face
fields.name: image_url

fields.help_en: The sub-ID of a specific face in the multi-face template
fields.help_zh: 多脸模板对应的某个人脸的子ID
fields.name: template_face_id

ImageURL.description_en:
The URL of the fused image.
This URL is a temporary address that is valid for 30 minutes. After it expires, the URL becomes inaccessible. To save the file for a longer period or permanently, access the URL within 30 minutes and download the file to your own OSS bucket or other storage
ImageURL.description_zh:
融合后的图像URL地址。
该URL地址为临时地址，有效期为30分钟，过期后将无法访问。若需要长时间或者永久保存文件，请在30分钟内访问URL地址，下载文件转存到自己的OSS或者其他存储空间
